hunks.sol: Space warped along the path of its spearhead.

hunks.baseline: Space shuddered as if struck by an earthquake. A tremendous shock wave burst forth with a deafening roar and swept across a radius of more than a dozen *zhang*.
hunks.sol: Space shuddered as if struck by an earthquake. A tremendous shock wave burst forth with a deafening roar, sweeping everything within a dozen or so *zhang*.

hunks.baseline: An enormous cloud of dust swallowed the narrow gorge in an instant. From within it, two gusts of wind blew.
hunks.sol: An enormous cloud of dust swallowed the narrow gorge in an instant. Through it came two gusts of wind, hotter than a midsummer afternoon and more suffocating than the desert sands far to the west.

hunks.baseline: Hotter than the air on a midsummer afternoon, more suffocating than the scorching desert sands far to the west.
Two fists, grown from the same root, wreathed in flames of different colors.
hunks.sol: Two fists, born of the same root, wreathed in flames of different colors.

hunks.baseline: As he stared down the terrifying heat burning its way through space, the North Heaven Demon Lord thrust out his spearhead with all his strength.
hunks.sol: Staring into the terrifying heat burning its way through space, the North Heaven Demon Lord thrust out his spear with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: At its tip, a distant flash of light blazed.
hunks.sol: At the end of its path came a blinding flash.

hunks.baseline: It all began and ended in the blink of an eye.
hunks.sol: It all began and ended in an instant.

hunks.baseline: As if the primordial giant who was said to have split the world with a single axe had drawn in a deep breath, the air all around tightened taut. Then it burst outward, sweeping everything away.
hunks.sol: As if the primordial giant said to have split the world with a single axe had drawn a deep breath, the air on every side pulled taut. Then it burst outward, sweeping everything away.

hunks.baseline: What should this be called?
hunks.sol: What could they call it?

hunks.baseline: An explosion? Or a catastrophe?
hunks.sol: An explosion? A catastrophe?

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung and the people of Shanxi couldn’t find an answer.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung and the people of Shanxi had no answer.

hunks.baseline: Crushed beneath an overwhelming force they had never experienced before—no, one they couldn’t even have imagined—they could only watch as a vast wave of power swept toward them.
hunks.sol: Crushed beneath a force they had never experienced—no, never even imagined—they could only watch the vast wave of power sweep toward them.

hunks.baseline: To keep themselves from being swept up and flung away by the invisible shock wave, the people of Shanxi braced one another and drove their blades deep into the ground.
hunks.sol: To keep from being flung away by the invisible shock wave, the people of Shanxi braced one another and drove their blades deep into the ground.

hunks.baseline: Their ears rang.
Instinctive awe and terror tightened around their entire bodies.
hunks.sol: Their ears rang. Instinctive awe and terror gripped their bodies.

hunks.baseline: That was true of everyone except the few people who had caused this tremendous shock wave.
hunks.sol: All of them, that was, except the few people responsible for the shock wave.

hunks.baseline: In a realm neither eyes nor ears could perceive, Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang dodged the Force shooting along the spearhead and thrust out their fists.
hunks.sol: Moving in a realm beyond sight and sound, Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang dodged the Force shooting along its path and thrust out their fists.

hunks.baseline: Air erupted with a blast of terrible heat.
hunks.sol: Air erupted with terrible heat.

hunks.baseline: But when the flames, launched before the delayed boom, coiled through space, the North Heaven Demon Lord was already swooping down over their heads.
hunks.sol: The boom came late. By the time the flames that preceded it coiled through space, the North Heaven Demon Lord was already swooping down over their heads.

hunks.baseline: A spearhead slashed down at an angle.
hunks.sol: His spearhead slashed down at an angle.

hunks.baseline: Just as Jin Taekyung twisted his body, the Force carried on the spearhead swelled larger still and came crashing toward his shoulder.
hunks.sol: Just as Jin Taekyung twisted aside, the Force carried on the spearhead swelled and fell toward his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: That certainty flashed through the North Heaven Demon Lord’s mind. It was absolutely true.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord was certain of it. He was right.

hunks.baseline: Except what he had just cut wasn’t flesh and bone, but armor that glowed faintly red.
hunks.sol: Except he had cut faintly red armor, not flesh and bone.

hunks.baseline: Blood spurted from the split in the Fire Dragon Armor, cut open by the Force.
hunks.sol: Blood spurted through the split in the Fire Dragon Armor.

hunks.baseline: Even with the Temporary Strength Pill’s immense boost to his physical abilities, and even with several centuries’ worth of internal energy surging without end, he couldn’t withstand the strength of the young man before him.
hunks.sol: Even with his physical abilities pushed to their limits by the Temporary Strength Pill, even with several *jiazi* of internal energy welling up without end, he could not withstand the strength of the young man before him.

hunks.baseline: But even across the North Heaven Demon Lord’s vast world, Jin Taekyung was a monster the likes of which he had never seen.
hunks.sol: Yet in all the vast world the North Heaven Demon Lord had seen, Jin Taekyung was a monster without equal.

hunks.baseline: An achievement unbelievable for his age.
Physical abilities far beyond even those called superhuman. And for some reason, ever since defeating Jamukha, his movements and internal energy had grown faster and stronger still.
hunks.sol: His accomplishments were unbelievable for his age. His physical abilities far surpassed even those called superhuman. And for some reason, ever since defeating Jamukha, his movements had grown faster and stronger, and his internal energy more powerful.

hunks.baseline: That alone made him a dangerous opponent. But what chilled the North Heaven Demon Lord’s spine even more in that moment was the old monster fighting alongside the young one.
hunks.sol: That alone made him a dangerous opponent. But what chilled the North Heaven Demon Lord’s spine even more was the old monster fighting at the young one’s side.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang charged in with a palm strike brimming with terrifying heat. A reddish glow lit the North Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang charged in with a palm strike brimming with terrifying heat. Its glow lit the North Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes red.

hunks.baseline: There were no choices left, not even time to look for another.
hunks.sol: There was no other choice. No time even to look for one.

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord released the beloved weapon he had carried for years and kicked off the ground.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord let go of the cherished spear he had carried for so many years and kicked off the ground.

hunks.baseline: A burning pain that seemed to seep into his very soul.
hunks.sol: Burning pain seemed to seep into his very soul.

hunks.baseline: The flames surged after their retreating target. Even a glancing touch melted armor and scorched skin.
hunks.sol: The flames surged after him as he retreated. Even a glancing touch melted his armor and scorched his skin.

hunks.baseline: And as the North Heaven Demon Lord endured that instant of pain and stumbled backward in a desperate retreat, the spearhead that had left him for a new master flashed toward him.
hunks.sol: As he staggered backward through the pain, the spearhead that had left him for a new master flashed toward him.

hunks.baseline: Along with a quiet voice that suddenly reached his ear.

hunks.baseline: It took a long time to build something up, but it could all come crashing down in an instant.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead kept swinging, one strike after another, leaving the armor that had covered the North Heaven Demon Lord’s whole body all but useless.

hunks.sol: His armor was not the only thing melting and breaking beneath the flames that struck him without pause.

hunks.baseline: Everything he had accomplished as Murong Baek, everything he had hoped to accomplish as the North Heaven Demon Lord—his past and future, all of it—was turning to ashes and scattering, bit by bit.

hunks.sol: “Long ago, whenever I saw you, I had the same thought.”

hunks.sol: Blinding light-flames swallowed the darkness. The North Heaven Demon Lord instinctively looked up, their light turning his vision white.

hunks.baseline: “You really do have the kind of eyes no one can trust.”
hunks.sol: *Those eyes of yours always looked shifty to me.*

the North Heaven Demon Lord saw it.
hunks.sol: In that instant, the North Heaven Demon Lord saw it.

hunks.sol: The roar followed the movement a moment later, shaking everything around them.

hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord slammed deep into the cliff wall. He swallowed the blood surging up his throat.

hunks.baseline: He sensed his vision blurring and pushed himself up from the cliff that cradled him like a nest.
hunks.sol: His vision blurring, he pushed against the cliff wall cradling his body and tried to rise.

hunks.baseline: No—he tried to.
hunks.sol: Tried to.

hunks.baseline: Until a flash of light flickered through the dust cloud rising pale beyond the countless rock fragments raining down from the collision.
hunks.sol: A flash cut through the pale dust beyond the fragments of rock raining down from the collision.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead, wreathed in blue-white flame and cloaked in dreadful heat, pierced his shoulder. It smashed through bone and flesh and drove deep into the cliff.
hunks.sol: The spearhead, wreathed in blue-white flame and terrible heat, pierced his shoulder. It smashed through bone and flesh and lodged deep in the cliff.

hunks.baseline: But the North Heaven Demon Lord refused to give up. Through the pain that turned his vision white, he fought with all his strength.
hunks.sol: But the North Heaven Demon Lord refused to give up. Though pain turned his vision white, he struggled with all his strength.

hunks.baseline: At last, the spearhead came free—or rather, his body did.
hunks.sol: At last, the spearhead came free.
No—his body did.

hunks.baseline: Instead of pulling out the spear lodged deep in the cliff through his shoulder, the North Heaven Demon Lord gritted his teeth and tore his shoulder free. Then he kicked off the ground and shot upward.
hunks.sol: Rather than pull the spear from the cliff, the North Heaven Demon Lord gritted his teeth and tore his shoulder off the blade. Then he kicked off the ground and shot upward.

hunks.baseline: Away from the two monsters who had pushed him to the brink of death.
hunks.sol: Away from the two monsters who had driven him to the brink of death.

hunks.baseline: Toward the only path of escape before him.
hunks.sol: Toward the only path of escape left to him.

hunks.baseline: His body should have already collapsed from his terrible pain and injuries. His internal energy should have dwindled to a mere handful. But the Temporary Strength Pill’s effects made him forget all of it.
hunks.sol: The pain and injuries should have felled him long ago. His internal energy should have dwindled to a mere handful. But the Temporary Strength Pill made him forget both.

hunks.baseline: Thinking of the prey who would be frozen in disbelief beyond the thick dust cloud settling all around.
hunks.sol: He pictured the prey who would be standing frozen in disbelief beyond the thick dust cloud settling around them.

hunks.baseline: Thinking of the only lifeline that could save him from his predicament.
hunks.sol: The only lifeline that could save him.

hunks.baseline: The Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and Alliance Leader of Shanxi Province’s forces in today’s battle.
hunks.sol: The Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, and the Alliance Leader from Shanxi Province who had led its forces in today’s battle.

hunks.baseline: And, to someone, a precious member of the family.
hunks.sol: And someone’s precious flesh and blood.

hunks.baseline: *If I take him hostage, I can escape.*
hunks.sol: *If I capture him, I have a way out.*

hunks.baseline: He had spent his entire life as the heir—and then the Family Head—of the Murong Family, one of the Five Great Families.
hunks.sol: He had spent his life first as heir, then as Family Head of the Murong Family, one of the Five Great Families.

hunks.baseline: His insides had been black, but his outward face was clean.
hunks.sol: Black on the inside, white on the outside.

hunks.baseline: How many years had he spent hiding the teeth of a beast while living alongside them within the orthodox faction’s fence?
hunks.sol: How many years had he lived among the orthodox faction, hiding the teeth of a beast?

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord understood the people called orthodox better than anyone.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord knew those who called themselves orthodox better than anyone: their nature, their habits, the way they thought.

hunks.baseline: Their nature, their habits, their way of thinking—all of it.
He also knew that the young upstart of the Jin Family of Taiyuan who had cornered him alongside the Fire King was bound more tightly than anyone else by the word *righteousness*.
hunks.sol: He knew, too, that the young upstart of the Jin Family of Taiyuan who had cornered him alongside the Fire King was bound more tightly than anyone by the word *righteousness*.

hunks.baseline: *That’s why. It’s the biggest reason you can’t defeat me—or us.*
hunks.sol: *That’s why. It’s the greatest reason you can’t defeat me—or us.*

hunks.baseline: They had lost a battle in which both sides had given everything they had, and the grand plan they had been certain would succeed had gone up in smoke.
hunks.sol: They had lost a battle in which both sides had given everything, and the grand plan they had been certain would succeed had come to nothing.

hunks.baseline: But that didn’t mean it was the end.
hunks.sol: But that didn’t mean the end.

hunks.baseline: As long as he survived, another chance would come.
hunks.sol: If he survived, another chance would come.

hunks.baseline: In the not-too-distant future, before the sting of his defeat and his enemies’ cheers had faded, he would once more unfurl the Murong Family’s banner and stride across the land.
hunks.sol: Before the sting of his defeat and his enemies’ cheers had faded, he would once more raise the Murong Family’s banner and range across the land.

hunks.baseline: Beneath a dark sky, with his hidden fangs bared to the fullest.
hunks.sol: Beneath a dark sky, his hidden fangs bared.

hunks.baseline: *I will return. Even if I have to stake everything I have.*
hunks.sol: *I will return. Even if I have to stake everything on it.*

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord thought back on the defeat and humiliation he had suffered that day and renewed his resolve.
hunks.sol: Remembering the defeat and humiliation he had suffered today, the North Heaven Demon Lord renewed his resolve.

hunks.baseline: In that moment, his reason—numbed by pain and hope—couldn’t even recognize the foolishness of his decision.
hunks.sol: He failed to notice that pain and hope had numbed his reason into making a foolish judgment.

hunks.baseline: He couldn’t even properly wonder why Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung weren’t chasing him, even in this situation.
hunks.sol: He failed even to ask why Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung weren’t chasing him.

hunks.baseline: And at last, beyond the dispersing cloud of dust, the North Heaven Demon Lord saw Jin Wikyung—the man he had wanted so desperately to find.
hunks.sol: At last, beyond the dispersing dust, he saw Jin Wikyung—the man he had been so desperate to find.
